payout_quote: Official Udemy support 'Instructor revenue share': 'There is no fee to create and host a course on Udemy, and you can publish as many free and paid courses as you like.' 'Sales occurring through instructor promotions: instructors receive 97% of the revenue when the student purchases their content using an instructor's coupon or referral link.' 'Sales that do not occur through an instructor promotion: instructors receive 37% of the revenue for any Udemy sales where no instructor coupon or course referral link was used.'
steps: Create and publish a Udemy course (video content, no fee to host).
Set your course price (within Udemy's pricing tiers) or publish free.
Promote your course with your coupon/referral link for 97% of net revenue.
Earn 37% of net revenue on Udemy marketplace sales; payouts via Udemy's instructor payment system.
catches: Revenue share is a percentage of NET revenue — Udemy's marketplace sales pay only 37%, and 'net' deductions reduce the base.
Course prices on Udemy are heavily discounted by platform promotions; your listed price is rarely the sale price.
Creating a quality course takes 20-40+ hours of recording/editing with no guaranteed sales.
Payouts are monthly (per Udemy's instructor payout schedule); refunds/chargebacks reduce earnings.
biggest_catch: The 97% share only applies to sales through YOUR coupon or referral link — Udemy's own marketplace sales pay just 37% of net revenue, and deep platform discounting means most sales happen at the lower share.
eligibility: Expertise to teach a course; 18+; comply with Udemy's course quality standards.
timing: Monthly instructor payouts after sales accrue.

c1.evidence: Udemy — major online course marketplace; official support.udemy.com.

c2.evidence: Official Udemy 'Instructor revenue share' article fetched live 2026-09-23.

notes: Course marketplace. No fee to create/host; 97% of net revenue on instructor-promoted sales, 37% on marketplace sales. Highly variable; most instructors earn little.
